title: Fancy Dress Party
hook: 佩奇家办化装舞会，朋友们扮成护士、胡萝卜、女巫，佩奇当评委却把奖给了自己。

cells.q: What kind of party are they having?
cells.a: They are having a fancy dress party with all their friends.
cells.cn: 他们和所有朋友一起办化装舞会。

cells.q: Who came to the party as a nurse?
cells.a: A nurse has arrived, and Daddy Pig says he is glad.
cells.cn: 来了一位护士，猪爸爸说他很高兴。

cells.q: What did they ask Rebecca Rabbit?
cells.a: They asked her what she is dressed as.

cells.q: Why is everyone surprised at Rebecca?
cells.a: Because she is dressed as a carrot, and she says woof!
cells.cn: 因为她扮成了一根胡萝卜，还“汪”了一声。

cells.q: What did the little witch say?
cells.a: She said, “I can turn you into a frog.”
cells.cn: 她说：“我能把你变成青蛙。”

cells.q: What did Peppa ask Daddy Pig?
cells.a: She asked him what a judge is.
Suzy is a witch, and she says she can turn you into a frog.
cells.cn: 苏西扮成女巫，说能把人变成青蛙。

cells.a: Peppa's little brother George is a scary dinosaur.
cells.cn: 佩奇的弟弟乔治是一只可怕的恐龙。

cells.q: Who is the judge of the best costume?
cells.a: Peppa is the judge, and she has to pick the winner.
cells.cn: 佩奇当评委，得由她来选出最好的服装。
